column_description: Why the prisoner was moved, as a CHG_HOUS_RSN code such as HOSP or VP. Also used as the case note subType, which is what caps it at 12 characters. There is deliberately no check constraint - see reference-data.csv for the permitted values.

table_description: A prisoner being moved to a different cell, with the reason and the explanation. Replaces whereabouts-api's CELL_MOVE_REASON: the important difference is that the explanation is held here rather than only in a case note, so the case note becomes a derived artefact that can be recreated, and "what happened" can be served in one hop.
column_description: The mover's free-text explanation. Always present for a CELL_MOVE, never present for a CELL_SWAP, because the swap journey does not ask for one. Deliberately unbounded: the case notes service is the source of truth for case note text and imposes no limit, so bounding it here would invent a constraint the system of record does not have. In practice it records violence, self harm, bullying and health, so treat it as Article 9 data whatever the question asked.
